translations.translatedText: # Radio | Clear News | Tuesday 30.5.2023
Government negotiations. Strikes in private social services. Harassment at work. Drone strike on Moscow. Weather forecast.
## Government negotiations

![Government formateur, National Coalition chairman Petteri Orpo at the government negotiations press conference at the House of Estates in Helsinki on 30 May 2023.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5119,h_2879,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-11218426475c47a26b79/1685439642)
Open image viewer
National Coalition chairman Petteri Orpo leads the government negotiations. Photo: Vesa Moilanen / Lehtikuva
The government negotiations have progressed a long way. That is what government formateur, National Coalition chairman Petteri Orpo, says.

Orpo says that the work of many working groups is almost ready. Different working groups have negotiated different matters. The most difficult matters are left: the funding of social and health services and savings in public finances. The savings target is 6 billion euros.
The government negotiations are in their 5th week. The National Coalition, the Finns Party, the Swedish People's Party and the Christian Democrats are taking part in the government negotiations.
## Strikes in private social services

![A nurse helps a resident of a care home into a wheelchair.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1643,h_923,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-98060062cc12b91770e/1657541680)
Open image viewer
The negotiations in private social services did not reach agreement on Tuesday. Photo: Mirva Ekman / Yle

New strikes begin in private social services on Wednesday. The reason is a pay dispute. The negotiations in private social services did not reach agreement on Tuesday on the collective agreement. That is why strikes begin on Wednesday in Uusimaa and Southwest Finland.
The strike begins at about 200 day-care centres and at about 20 child welfare units.
In addition, a strike begins at elderly care units on Thursday in Uusimaa and Southwest Finland.
## Harassment at work
![People on a restaurant terrace.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5000,h_2813,x_0,y_523/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-81291660b13c4a5aba5/1622623795)
Open image viewer
Harassment can take many forms. For example, in service sectors people encounter many others. Photo: Henrietta Hassinen / Yle

Many Finns experience harassment at work. Harassment is most experienced in the social and health sector, in retail and in consumer services. That is what a new survey says. In the social and health sector about 75 percent of employees have experienced harassment.

Harassment can take many forms. The most common experience of harassment is that a person does not dare to state their own opinion at work. The second most common experience of harassment is that an employee is not listened to, or an employee has been insulted at work. Harassment also includes staring at a worker
Women in particular also experience sexual harassment. Almost 25 percent of Finns have at some point experienced sexual harassment at work.
## Drone strike on Moscow

![Damage from drone strikes on an apartment block in Moscow on 30 May 2023.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5120,h_2880,x_0,y_4/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-11218716475c69e2c585/1685440428)
Open image viewer
Drones damaged 2 apartment blocks. Photo: Kirill Kudryavtsev / AFP
Moscow, the Russian capital, was attacked at night with unmanned aircraft, that is, drones. The drones slightly damaged two (2) apartment blocks.
Russia blames Ukraine for the drone strikes. Ukraine says that Ukraine has not sent drones to Moscow. Also at the beginning of May there was a drone attack on the Kremlin in Moscow.

Military experts say that Ukraine may have sent the drones. Doctor of Military Sciences **Ilmari Käihkö** tells Yle that the drone strikes are a big failure for the Russian leadership. Russians see that a drone attack can also come to Russia.
## The weather

In the east and north there will be rain showers.
On Wednesday in the east and north there will be rain showers. In the west it is mostly dry. The temperature is between 10 and 20 degrees.
